name: Domenico Fiorillo

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Saveria Colosimo in the parish church

bioAdditions: Domenico (styled 'Gabriele Fiorillo' in the register) married Saveria Colosimo, daughter of Raffaele, in the San Mango parish on 1 April 1870; his father Carmine was already dead (S1). Seven children were baptized between 1871 and 1886: Giuseppina (John's ancestor, 1871), Carmelo (1873), Filomena (1874), Carolina (1877), Carmine (1880), Antonio (1884) and Gaetano (1886). Gaetano married Maria Mendicino in 1909 (S3). He did not emigrate. The parish burial register records Domenico Fiorillo, aged 81, son of the late Carmine and the late Giuseppa Ferlaino, buried at San Mango on 27 August 1921 (S2). This conflicts with the tree's death year of 1927.

conflicts.foundValue: 27 Aug 1921 (age 81, parents Carmine and Giuseppa Ferlaino)
conflicts.assessment: The index entry matches his parents and age exactly; prefer 1921 unless the tree's 1927 has a source.
